stage1.impression: A warm, brown, timber-lined listening bar at night with pools of light on a long counter and a full record wall. It has the mood of a kissa, but the speakers, which should be the altar, are hidden. Large pale long-exposure ghosts smear across both speaker niches, the Dome pendants read as white enamel industrial shades with near-blown liners, and the zinc counter reads as flat grey plaster. At 1:1 it reads as a well-lit CG render with a long-exposure filter, not a photograph. As it stands a design magazine would take it for a generic warm record bar: the parts that make it specific (the EARF speakers in their niches, the concrete shell) do not come through.

blocking_9: Both Atmosphere speakers in the back-bar niches read at a glance: silhouette, smoked tint and horn, with no figure blurred across them (speaker niche lum_median below 110 with no pale overlay)
No clipped or near-white flat shapes inside the speaker niches (the white quad at the left horn mouth)
Dome pendants read as tinted acrylic with a glowing frosted liner, not white enamel: liner below clipping, with the shade's smoke tint visible
Zinc counter reads as metal: an uneven patina, soft specular streaks from the Domes, and pools that fall off, not a uniform grey plaster slab
At least one board-formed concrete or blackened-steel surface in frame so the shell reads as this specific place
No translucent diagonal streaks in the ceiling and beams
Ghost figures kept to the room's edges and the bartender, at a lower opacity, with clean shapes, not pink-white smears

defects.what: A pale pink and white long-exposure ghost (a counter guest) covers the left speaker's woofer and cabinet; the speaker is unreadable (lum_median 149, should be a dark smoked cabinet)
The selector's ghost smears across the right niche's speaker; the Dome pendant also hangs directly in front of that niche
A flat, near-white trapezoid at the left horn's mouth (p95 241) reads as a blown hole or an unlit emissive card
Dome pendant liner near clipping (clip 0.92 %, median 211); the shade reads as white enamel, with no smoked acrylic visible

Zinc top is a uniform matte grey (median 177 under the pool) with no patina, scratches or specular sheen; it reads as plaster or concrete. The pool of light runs 137 to 192 in the middle and drops sharply to 32 to 60 on the right
Translucent diagonal streaks across the ceiling beams and the right wall (motion-blurred geometry or a ghost limb)
A second faint diagonal streak through the beams
Coaster and napkin discs with soft halo shadows, slightly floating; a green and red coin smear reads as a CG decal
Candle flame reads as a red dot inside an opaque tinted votive; it gives no glow on the zinc around it
Pink-white ghost blob at the right edge with no readable figure; a hand or arm shape floats in mid-air
Overall sepia cast with a uniform warm tone and a slight milky lift in the mids; not one surface reads as a saturated product colour, and no board-formed concrete or blackened steel is visible

changes.problem: Long-exposure ghosts sit directly in front of both speaker niches and wash them out, so the hero product is invisible.

evidence.measured: left niche lum_median 148.7, r/g/b 165/146/128 (pale pink coat overlay); right niche [690,330,770,480] median 159.2, p95 244

change.from: 3 at the counter (one standing in front of the left niche), selector in front of the right niche, shutter 1.0 frame
change.to: move the counter guest to the stools at x 1000 to 1200 and the selector behind the decks, below the niche's lower edge; shutter 0.5 frame; keep the bartender's blur between the niches only

changes.expected: Both smoked speakers read as dark tinted cabinets with their woofers and horns visible; no pale overlay inside either niche.

changes.problem: The speakers are not lit as an altar; the left horn's mouth shows a flat near-white shape while the cabinet gets no modelling light.

evidence.measured: p95 240.9, lum_range 220.9 on a flat trapezoid

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area (and the lit niche's strip)
change.to: 0.5 W/m2 at the target, plus a narrow grazing spot from the niche head (about 6 W, 2700 K, 25 deg) to edge-light the cabinet; strip 0.06

changes.expected: The horn mouth falls to a soft grey glow; the cabinet's polished acrylic edges catch a highlight, so the silhouette reads.

changes.problem: The Dome liners are near clipping and read as white enamel shades rather than smoked acrylic.

change.setting: each Dome: W and liner glow

changes.expected: The liner glows warm without clipping and the outer shell shows its smoked tint as a darker rim.

changes.problem: The zinc counter reads as matte grey plaster: uniform, no patina, no sheen.

evidence.measured: lum_median 177.3 under the pool, flat; zinc reads as plaster at 1:1

change.to: darker blue-grey base (about #6E7276), roughness 0.25 to 0.45 broken up by a large-scale wipe and ring-mark map, with fine scratches along the counter's length

changes.expected: Soft specular streaks under each Dome, darker metal between the pools, and visible ring marks under glasses.

changes.problem: The frame crops the left speaker against the edge, hangs a pendant in front of the right one, and shows no concrete or steel, so it reads as a generic timber bar.

evidence.measured: left niche cut at x 160 to 350; Dome at [730,290,800,330] overlaps the right niche; no concrete visible

change.to: position about [3.0, 2.2, 1.25], target about [7.8, 5.9, 1.45], 40 mm, so that both niches sit between pendants inside the frame, with a strip of board-formed concrete wall or steel at the left edge

changes.expected: Both speakers sit framed in their niches, clear of the pendants, with the zinc leading the eye into them; one shell material other than timber appears.

changes.problem: Translucent diagonal streaks cross the ceiling beams, a classic motion-blur artefact.

evidence.measured: pale diagonal bands over beams with lum_median 22.4; visible at 2x crop

change.from: shutter 1.0 frame, the head's travel [0.2, 0.12, 0.03] m
change.to: shutter 0.5 frame; exclude ceiling-height geometry (pendant cords, raised arms) from motion blur

changes.expected: Clean, continuous fir beams with their checks and grain readable.

changes.problem: The pool of light on the counter falls off sharply to the right, and the back bar's right half and the far wall are dull, so the far end is lost.

evidence.measured: profile x 16/85/137/192/177/61/32/40: a hard drop past x 620

change.from: 4 x spot 20.0 W, 2400 K, cone 20 deg
change.to: 4 x spot 14 W, 2400 K, cone 30 deg, and raise the far two to 18 W so the pools repeat down the counter

changes.expected: Repeating pools along the zinc with soft darker gaps between them, not one hot patch.

changes.problem: The candles read as red dots inside opaque votives and add no warm glow; the coin and napkin props look like floating decals.

evidence.measured: the red dot is the only light; no pool on the zinc around it at 3x crop

change.setting: candles 2 x point, the votives, the props
change.to: 5.0 W, 1900 K, in clear or amber glass votives, placed one per pair of guests; seat napkins and coins flat with contact shadows

changes.expected: A small warm pool on the zinc around each candle and believable small highlights on the glasses.

out_of_scope.request: Give the Dome pendants a darker or more visible smoked shell so they do not read as white enamel
out_of_scope.why: The Dome is an EARF product; its shape, tint and parts are fixed. Only its wattage and glow may change (c3).

out_of_scope.request: Add board-formed concrete or blackened steel to the back bar where it is now all timber
out_of_scope.why: The room's materials and the back bar are fixed by the design; only the camera can bring the existing concrete or steel into frame (c5).

out_of_scope.request: Give the smoked configuration a coloured tint so the speaker carries the frame's one saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The configuration's colour is fixed; Smoke is the house configuration.
